context: Migrated from a flat scenario file. Tests: Multi-Step Order Processing System.

checklist.name: Single behavior per test
checklist.description: Each test verifies only one workflow step or one specific behavior, not the entire order lifecycle

checklist.name: No behavior combination
checklist.description: Avoids tests that cover create/validate/pay/fulfill in one test case

checklist.name: Visible test data
checklist.description: All order data, test scenarios, and expected states are defined within test files

checklist.name: Independent test cases
checklist.description: Tests don't rely on shared state or data from other tests — each test creates its own data

checklist.name: Logical test organization
checklist.description: Tests are grouped by workflow step or component, not mixed together randomly

checklist.name: Clear workflow step tests
checklist.description: Separate tests for each workflow transition (pending→validated, validated→paid, etc.)

checklist.name: Error scenario isolation
checklist.description: Failure cases tested independently for each step, not combined into one failure test

checklist.name: Descriptive test structure
checklist.description: Test names clearly identify which workflow step and scenario is being tested

checklist.name: Clean test setup
checklist.description: Each test creates minimal required data, no excess or irrelevant test objects

checklist.name: Avoids: A single test covers multiple workflow transitions...
checklist.description: Failure avoided: A single test covers multiple workflow transitions in sequence (create → validate → pay → fulfill)

checklist.name: Avoids: Tests combine multiple workflow step behaviors into...
checklist.description: Failure avoided: Tests combine multiple workflow step behaviors into one assertion block

checklist.name: Avoids: Test data is loaded from shared fixtures...
checklist.description: Failure avoided: Test data is loaded from shared fixtures or defined outside the test files

checklist.name: Avoids: Tests depend on state or data set...
checklist.description: Failure avoided: Tests depend on state or data set up by other tests in the suite

checklist.name: Avoids: Tests for different workflow steps are not...
checklist.description: Failure avoided: Tests for different workflow steps are not organized or grouped logically

checklist.name: Avoids: No individual tests exist for specific workflow...
checklist.description: Failure avoided: No individual tests exist for specific workflow transitions

checklist.name: Avoids: Failure cases for multiple steps are tested...
checklist.description: Failure avoided: Failure cases for multiple steps are tested in a single combined failure test

checklist.name: Avoids: Test names do not indicate which workflow...
checklist.description: Failure avoided: Test names do not indicate which workflow step or scenario is under test

checklist.name: Avoids: Tests set up unnecessary data or objects...
checklist.description: Failure avoided: Tests set up unnecessary data or objects beyond what the test requires
